entries.headline: Fable details 'Style Weaving' combat, freely mixing melee, ranged, and magic
entries.summary: Playground Games further details Fable's 'Style Weaving' combat: players can freely combine melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic across the three ability categories of Strength, Skill, and Will, and use spells like 'Chicken' to control enemies or alter exploration routes; the game also offers adjustable combat intensity.

entries.headline: Fable shows 18 minutes of quest gameplay, featuring Bowerstone exploration and consequences of choices
entries.summary: Xbox reveals approximately 18 minutes of quest gameplay for Fable, centered on the reimagined Bowerstone, showcasing enterable buildings, property purchase, quest progression with Humphry, as well as systems like choices and consequences and combat. The game is set to release on February 23, 2027, with Premium Edition early access on February 18.
entries.verification: Primary source Xbox Wire opened; gameplay length, quest location, systems, and release information all come from that page.

entries.headline: Marvel's Wolverine details systems, showcasing 'Adaptive Abilities' and rage-fueled combat
entries.summary: Insomniac reveals a features trailer for Marvel's Wolverine, further showcasing fast-paced combat emphasizing close-quarters pressure, as well as 'Adaptive Abilities' that can enhance damage resistance, rage efficiency, and parry windows. The trailer also adds characters like Trask, Jean Grey, and Team X, along with side challenges and collectibles.

entries.headline: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.2 'Her and Her Hidden Past' launches September 9, adds 'Feng Yu' class
entries.summary: miHoYo announces Zenless Zone Zero version 3.2 'Her and Her Hidden Past' will launch on September 9. The update introduces a new Agent class 'Feng Yu', with S-rank Electric Feng Yu Agent Clara in the first half and S-rank Wind Stun Agent Roxy in the second half, along with story content and login rewards.

entries.headline: Shadow of the Road launches November 12 on PC
entries.summary: Owlcat Games announces the turn-based strategy RPG Shadow of the Road will launch on November 12 on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG. Set in an alternate 1868 Japan, the game blends samurai, steam machinery, and yokai elements.

entries.headline: Motive confirms Iron Man game still in development, no new timeline announced
entries.summary: EA's Motive Studio confirms its Iron Man action-adventure game is still in development and will share more information when ready. This confirmation ends a long period without official progress updates, but the studio gave no release window, platforms, or new gameplay footage.

entries.headline: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline rescheduled to September 11
entries.summary: Creek & River announces the first-person psychological mystery game The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline will digitally launch on September 11 for PC and PS5, priced at 3,520 yen; a PS5 physical edition is planned for December 10. The game reinterprets Dante's Divine Comedy in a modern way.

entries.headline: Witch's Garden leaves Early Access with full release, combat and growth systems overhauled
entries.summary: Team Tapas' top-down witch roguelike Witch's Garden is now fully released on PC. A major update simultaneously overhauls combat and growth systems, adds Japanese voice acting through Chapter 5, and completes the main story; a 30% discount is available during the full release period.
